title: Quantitative proteome of bacterial periplasmic predation reveals a prey damaging protease
authors: Lai TF; Jankov D; Grossmann J; Roschitzki B; Huwiler SG
one_liner_zh: 该文研究捕食性细菌的定量蛋白质组学与蛋白酶功能，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The rise of antimicrobial resistant pathogens calls for novel ways to kill and damage bacteria. A rich source for bacterial cell-damaging proteins is periplasmic predatory bacterium Bdellovibrio bacteriovorus , which invades, kills and subsequently exits the Gram-negative prey cell. An increased understanding of predatory protein function can be achieved by analyzing their relative abundance at key stages of predation. Here, we present the first quantitative proteome covering the complete predatory life cycle of the bacterial predator B. bacteriovorus killing Escherichia coli , quantifying 2195 predator proteins. From these proteins, nine protein clusters sharing similar expression patterns were identified. Towards the end of the life cycle when the predator exits prey remnants, we identified significant amounts of protease Bd2269. Gene knockout and heterologous expression experiments revealed that Bd2269 is involved in the prey exit process and damages E. coli from within. This quantitative predator proteome is a valuable resource to unravel bacterial predator-prey interactions and advances the search for novel antimicrobial enzymes.
abstract_zh: 抗菌耐药病原体的增加要求我们寻找新的方法来杀灭和损伤细菌。细菌细胞损伤蛋白的一个丰富来源是周质捕食性细菌 *Bdellovibrio bacteriovorus*，它侵入、杀死并随后退出革兰氏阴性猎物细胞。通过分析捕食性蛋白在捕食关键阶段的相对丰度，可以加深对其功能的理解。在此，我们展示了首个覆盖细菌捕食者 *B. bacteriovorus* 杀死 *Escherichia coli* 完整捕食生命周期的定量蛋白质组，共定量了2195种捕食者蛋白。从这些蛋白中，我们识别出九个表达模式相似的蛋白簇。在生命周期末期，当捕食者退出猎物残骸时，我们鉴定到显著量的蛋白酶Bd2269。基因敲除和异源表达实验表明，Bd2269参与猎物退出过程，并从内部损伤 *E. coli*。该定量捕食者蛋白质组是揭示细菌捕食者-猎物相互作用的宝贵资源，并推进了新型抗菌酶的搜索。
